source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?mascotLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?m) AS ?mascot) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?item wdt:P822 ?m . ?item rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(LANG(?l)="en" && REGEX(STR(?l),"^[0-9]{4} (Summer|Winter) Olympics$")) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?n = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

rows.label: 2024 Summer Olympics
rows.description: games of the XXXIII Olympiad, in Paris, France
rows.hook: made its city only the second ever to host the Games three times, after London

rows.label: 2026 Winter Olympics

rows.hook: was the first Games ever officially shared between two cities, and the debut of ski mountaineering

rows.label: 2020 Summer Olympics
rows.description: games of the XXXII Olympiad, in Tokyo, Japan, held in 2021
rows.hook: was delayed a full year by the COVID-19 pandemic yet kept its original name, and was played without spectators

rows.label: 2012 Summer Olympics
rows.description: Games of the XXX Olympiad, in London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: made its city the first ever to host the modern Games three times

rows.label: 2016 Summer Olympics

rows.hook: was the first Games held in South America and the first in a Portuguese-speaking country

rows.label: 2008 Summer Olympics
rows.description: Games of the XXIX Olympiad, in Beijing, China
rows.hook: was the first Games hosted by the world's most populous country, drawing 204 national teams

rows.label: 1972 Summer Olympics
rows.description: Games of the XX Olympiad, in Munich, West Germany

rows.label: 1996 Summer Olympics

rows.label: 2000 Summer Olympics
rows.description: Games of the XXVII Olympiad, in Sydney, Australia
rows.hook: was nicknamed the Games of the New Millennium and was the first to have at least 300 events

rows.label: 2004 Summer Olympics
rows.description: Games of the XXVIII Olympiad, in Athens, Greece

rows.label: 1984 Summer Olympics

rows.label: 1988 Summer Olympics

rows.label: 1992 Summer Olympics
rows.description: Games of the XXV Olympiad in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain

rows.label: 1980 Summer Olympics

rows.label: 2022 Winter Olympics
rows.description: 24th edition of Winter Olympics, in Beijing, China
rows.hook: made its city the first ever to host both the hot-weather and cold-weather Games, with no fans at first

rows.label: 1976 Summer Olympics
